name: scolia-score-reader
description: Browser extension (Chrome + Firefox) that reports finished Scolia matches to a fusion-local darts season.

scripts.pack: npm run build && for t in chrome firefox; do (cd dist/$t && zip -qrX ../scolia-score-reader-$t.zip . -x '.*' -x '*/.*'); done
scripts.icons: for s in 16 32 48 128; do sips -z $s $s android-chrome-512x512.png --out public/icons/icon-$s.png; done
